incompleteRules.cause: Axe reports bgGradient, so it cannot determine the backdrop automatically.
incompleteRules.manualResolution: CSS gradient-stop channel bounds and the WCAG relative-luminance formula establish a conservative contrast above 4.5:1 for all four nodes.

manualContrast.formula: (L_lighter + 0.05) / (L_darker + 0.05); convert sRGB channels to linear light, then use 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B
manualContrast.method: Take the minimum of each backdrop RGB channel across the gradient stops. Because all stops are lighter than the text and luminance increases with each channel, this synthetic backdrop bounds the whole gradient conservatively.
